_comment: Routing/property registry for the Notion task sync (.claude/commands/notion-sync.md, contracts/notion-task-schema.md). All Notion ids, property names, and vocabulary strings live here so a renamed property or a new source is a one-line data edit, never a code change. Source: Albert's live Notion workspace, verified 2026-07-27.
_maintenance: Notion property/status strings are EXACT MATCH (e.g. 'Not started' lowercase s). If someone renames a property or status option in Notion, this file goes stale silently — the sync will start failing writes. Re-verify against the live schema (notion-fetch on the data_source url) whenever a write starts erroring on an unknown property/option.
_ghl_location_id_comment: Used to CONSTRUCT the url property for every created row: https://app.gohighlevel.com/v2/location/<ghl_location_id>/contacts/detail/<contactId>. Never copy item.link verbatim — message-type items link to /conversations/conversations/, not /contacts/detail/.

team._comment: Shared 'Tactical Tasks List' database, Titan Flooring HQ teamspace. Auto-write.

private._comment: Reuses Albert's existing personal 'to-do' database (under 'to-do list (personal)' page, Albert's Notion Directory > PERSONAL), filtered by its 'Private To Do' view. NOT a new database. Notes/url/Source properties were added 2026-07-27 to support this sync; Status/Priority/tags/Assignee/Due Date/Task already existed and are unchanged. Approval-gated: the sync must always propose-and-stop for this destination, never auto-write.

source_defaults._comment: Default destination per ingest source. A new *-ingest source needs only one line here — no writer code change. An item's own `sensitivity` field (contracts/ingest-schema.md) may escalate team -> private, never the reverse.

people._comment: Notion person IDs behind the Tactical Tasks List per-person views. The sync NEVER sets Assign To (contracts/notion-task-schema.md rule 4) — this table exists for reference/reporting only (e.g. to name whose view a row would land in once triaged), not for the sync to assign into.
